title: Derivative library và packaging QA
scope_items: Database Migration 00024: Created repurpose_jobs, ab_test_experiments, packaging_qa_results, and upload_presets tables with composite tenant foreign keys to workspaces and assets; strict multi-tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY); exact numeric money/credits (DB-H-001); narrow role grants to app_user and admin_user; and verified 24-step reversible down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (150-item partial batch results): Batch tagging and bulk operations handle batches of >=100 items (tested on 150 items) with structured partial failure reporting ('147/150 succeeded. 3 failed: [view details].') and granular per-item error codes.
Acceptance Target 2 (No lineage -> routing denied): Assets without parent_asset_id lineage are strictly denied routing to packaging/publish (RULE-M09-001, AC 5) with ErrMissingLineage.

Acceptance Target 3 (Hard blocks cannot be workspace-overridden): Commercial content without disclosure (isCommercial: true with empty disclosure) and confirmed copyright violations are hard-blocked (isHardBlocked: true, canOverride: false). Hard blocks cannot be overridden by any role, including Manager, Admin, or Owner (SAFE-2026-02, RULE-M10-002). Only reviewable warnings can be overridden by Manager+ with justification >= 10 chars.

RULE-M10-006 & API Behavior §7: A/B testing experiment evaluations under 1,000 impressions per variant are marked inconclusive with empty winner, and conclusive once impressions >= 1,000 and lift >= 1.2x.
RULE-M09-003: Aggregated derivative performance metrics calculate total views, average engagement rate, and platform distribution across linked children.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_150ItemPartialBatchResults (Go -race), Vitest web suite (derivative_packaging.test.ts), and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm 150-item batch operation with 147 successes and 3 failures returning exact count and summary message.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_NoLineageRoutingDenied (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm orphan derivatives without parent_asset_id fail routing with ErrMissingLineage / LineageError / LineageException.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_HardBlocksCannotBeWorkspaceOverridden (Go -race), Vitest web suite, and Flutter acceptance test suite confirm commercial content without disclosure produces a non-overridable hard block, and Manager+ override succeeds only for reviewable warnings with reason >= 10 chars.
Lineage Inspection & Deletion Verified: TestLineageTreeInspectionAndSourceDeletion verifies parent source deletion preserves children with archived flag (EC-M09-001).
A/B Testing Threshold Verified: TestABExperimentInconclusiveUnderEvidenceThreshold confirms inconclusive status under 1000 impressions (RULE-M10-006).
Migration 00024 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 24 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: proto-gen.sh verify passes Buf lint, codegen across Go, TypeScript, and Dart, git drift verification, TypeScript compilation, and Dart generated code analyze.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), vitest (derivative_packaging.test.ts passing), vite build and SSR adapter-node smoke, and flutter analyze / tests all pass cleanly.
external_gates: Production packaging hook scoring and multimodal compliance scanning require production Vision-Language API credentials and live billing accounts. Deterministic 6-factor scorecard and compliance validation verified locally.

Migration 00024 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow role grants verified via local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.

remaining_scope.note: Cross-service end-to-end integration and gamification across M07/M08/M09/M10.

decisions: ADR-P4-08-001: 150-item batch operations return structured partial success summaries (e.g. '147/150 succeeded. 3 failed: [view details].') with granular per-item error codes.
ADR-P4-08-002: Assets without parent_asset_id lineage are strictly blocked from packaging and publishing with ErrMissingLineage (RULE-M09-001).

ADR-P4-08-003: Hard blocks (confirmed rights violations, missing commercial disclosure) are non-overridable even by Workspace Manager or Owner (SAFE-2026-02, RULE-M10-002). Only reviewable warnings can be overridden with reason >= 10 chars by Manager+.
ADR-P4-08-004: A/B experiments require >= 1000 impressions per variant before declaring a conclusive winner (RULE-M10-006).
